title.zh: 批准苏萨诺·B·马克西洛姆依第3232号共和国法享有的全部权利转让给东方广播公司的法案
title.en: An Act Approving the Transfer of All Rights of Susano B. Maxilom Under Republic Act Numbered Thirty-Two Hundred Thirty-Two, in Favor of Eastern Broadcasting Corporation
title.orig: An Act Approving the Transfer of All Rights of Susano B. Maxilom Under Republic Act Numbered Thirty-Two Hundred Thirty-Two, in Favor of Eastern Broadcasting Corporation

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1972/ra_6549_1972.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The transfer of all the rights of Susano B. Maxilom, under Republic Act Numbered Thirty-two hundred and thirty-two, entitled "An Act granting Susano B. Maxilom a franchise to construct, operate and maintain radio broadcasting stations and stations for television in the Philippines," in favor of Eastern Broadcasting Corporation, is approved.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, August 26, 1972.
